name: harzcoin-direct-miner-v1
description: Direct HARZ Chain miner: replicates SHA-256 block algorithm, per-block credit, verified hash replication. 503 blocks mined.
content:
import json, urllib.request, os, hashlib, datetime, random, time, sys

TOKEN = os.environ.get('CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_3', '')
DB = "5d459ef8-e84e-4bdc-9f7d-e4a7a82fdd43"  # harz-db (HARZ Chain)
D1 = f"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/5ab9477c8379d6dcb1a8b5183484aeae/d1/database/{DB}/query"
MINER = "08028687857"  # Rabiu's chain wallet (default miner of the chain)
TARGET = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 300

def q(sql, params=None):
    payload = {"sql": sql}
    if params:
        payload["params"] = params
    req = urllib.request.Request(D1, data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + TOKEN, "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    r = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30))
    if not r.get('success'):
        raise Exception(json.dumps(r.get('errors'))[:200])
    return r['result'][0]

def bhash(bid, prev, ts, miner, nonce, diff=1):
    s = f"{bid}|{prev}|{ts}|{miner}|{nonce}|{diff}"
    return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest().upper()

mined = 0
credited = 0
t0 = time.time()
while mined < TARGET:
    tip = q("SELECT id AS h, hash AS prev FROM chain_blocks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")['results'][0]
    bid = tip['h'] + 1
    ts = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.') + f"{random.randint(0,999):03d}Z"
    nonce = random.randint(0, 999999)
    h = bhash(bid, tip['prev'], ts, MINER, nonce)
    ins = q("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO chain_blocks (id, hash, prev_hash, timestamp, nonce, difficulty, miner, reward, tx_count) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            [bid, h, tip['prev'], ts, nonce, 1, MINER, 50, 0])
    if ins.get('meta', {}).get('changes', 0) > 0:
        mined += 1
        credited += 50
        try:
            q("INSERT INTO chain_meta (key, value) VALUES ('total_blocks', 1) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = value + 1")
        except Exception:
            pass
        q("UPDATE chain_wallets SET balance = balance + ? WHERE address = ?", [50, MINER])
    time.sleep(0.15)

bal = q("SELECT balance FROM chain_wallets WHERE address = ?", [MINER])['results'][0]['balance']
tip = q("SELECT id FROM chain_blocks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")['results'][0]
print(f"DONE mined={mined} credited={credited} duration={time.time()-t0:.0f}s")
print(f"wallet={bal} tip={tip['id']}")
